title: MCPollinations gets the right credit
summary:
A housekeeping day: correct project credit, tidier text model routing, and changes to referral matching.

Corrected the MCPollinations author credit to Pink Pixel in the project list and README. Its description and links stayed the same.

Refactored DeepSeek and Portkey handling in the text API, including model mappings and endpoint selection for DeepSeek-V3.

Added three affiliates to referral matching. Text responses no longer need Markdown formatting to be eligible for referral links, while the chance of showing Ko-fi when nothing matches was reduced.
